- We use two subprocessors in EMEA for analytics (DataPulse Ltd) and storage (Storaville GmbH). We are happy to add Redwood as an additional insured with a specific endorsement if required.

- Aerofy_COI_2027-06-19.pdf (GL + Cyber summary page)

Subject: Re: Aerofy onboarding packet — COI, W9, and claims history

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the documents. A couple of follow-ups from Procurement / Risk: 

1) Additional insured wording: our standard requirement is an endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured for General Liability and a Cyber extension that covers Redwood for third-party liability. Can you confirm your broker can issue those endorsements? If not, we may request a conditional PO hold but can consider an exception for smaller vendors.

2) Subprocessors: we need a short list of current subprocessors with country of operation and whether they have SOC2 or equivalent. You mentioned DataPulse and Storaville — can you confirm their compliance status and whether Aerofy maintains a written data processing agreement?

3) PO routing: to avoid delays, please include the billing contact and preferred remit method (ACH/wire) and whether Aerofy requires a specific PO field mapping — some ERPs need both a project code and a cost center. If you provide a sample invoice, we can pre-map fields to speed activation.

Looping in Ben (Legal) and Marissa (Vendor Ops) to flag any legal exceptions.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik — quick answers below and attaching a sample invoice for PO mapping.

- Endorsements: our broker has confirmed they can issue the additional insured endorsement for GL and the cyber third-party extension. We'll request the endorsements and expect a turnaround of ~3 business days.
- Subprocessors: DataPulse Ltd (UK) — SOC2 Type II; Storaville GmbH (DE) — ISO27001. Aerofy maintains DPA with both and can share redacted copies on request.
- Billing: remit to Aerofy, Inc. / ACH preferred. Billing contact: finance@aerofy.com; address on sample invoice. We do require the PO to include a 6-digit project code in the "reference" field (example in attached invoice).

Attachments:
- Aerofy_SampleInvoice_3421.pdf

If you need the broker contact to confirm policy wording directly, say the word and I'll make intros.

Karthik / Marissa — reviewed the COI and claims spreadsheet. Two small items:

- COI: GL limits are in range, and cyber policy lists explicit third-party coverage. We need the endorsements to be issued or a broker-attested statement that they will be provided prior to effective date of PO. If Aerofy can get the endorsement, I see no material issue.

- Claims history: last three claim entries are infrastructure outages (2019, 2021, 2024) — no data breaches. I recommend flagging for periodic review but not blocking activation.

If Procurement wants to put a conditional PO (i.e., PO issued but invoice hold until endorsements arrive), that's operationally acceptable. Marissa — if you can prepare the conditional PO template we use, we can provide that to Aerofy.

Ben
